name: jev-fabric
description: A typed decision control plane for bounded semantic choices.

scripts.coverage: pnpm --filter @mokimeow/jev-fabric-adapters test --coverage --coverage.include=packages/adapters/src/** --coverage.thresholds.lines=60 --coverage.thresholds.functions=60 --coverage.thresholds.branches=50 --coverage.thresholds.statements=60 && pnpm --filter @mokimeow/jev-fabric-protocol test --coverage --coverage.include=packages/protocol/src/** --coverage.thresholds.lines=60 --coverage.thresholds.functions=60 --coverage.thresholds.branches=50 --coverage.thresholds.statements=60 && pnpm --filter @mokimeow/jev-fabric-core test --coverage --coverage.include=packages/core/src/** --coverage.thresholds.lines=60 --coverage.thresholds.functions=60 --coverage.thresholds.branches=50 --coverage.thresholds.statements=60 && pnpm --filter @mokimeow/jev-fabric-provider-openai-compatible test --coverage --coverage.include=packages/provider-openai-compatible/src/** --coverage.thresholds.lines=60 --coverage.thresholds.functions=60 --coverage.thresholds.branches=50 --coverage.thresholds.statements=60 && pnpm --filter @mokimeow/jev-fabric-provider-typesafe test --coverage --coverage.include=packages/provider-typesafe/src/** --coverage.thresholds.lines=60 --coverage.thresholds.functions=60 --coverage.thresholds.branches=50 --coverage.thresholds.statements=60 && pnpm --filter @mokimeow/jev-fabric-evals test --coverage --coverage.include=packages/evals/src/** --coverage.thresholds.lines=60 --coverage.thresholds.functions=60 --coverage.thresholds.branches=50 --coverage.thresholds.statements=60 && pnpm --filter @mokimeow/jev-fabric-packs test --coverage --coverage.include=packs/**/pack.ts --coverage.thresholds.lines=60 --coverage.thresholds.functions=60 --coverage.thresholds.branches=50 --coverage.thresholds.statements=60 && pnpm --filter @mokimeow/jev-fabric-mcp test --coverage --coverage.include=packages/mcp/src/** --coverage.thresholds.lines=60 --coverage.thresholds.functions=60 --coverage.thresholds.branches=50 --coverage.thresholds.statements=60 && pnpm --filter @mokimeow/jev-fabric-cli test --coverage --coverage.include=packages/cli/src/** --coverage.thresholds.lines=60 --coverage.thresholds.functions=60 --coverage.thresholds.branches=50 --coverage.thresholds.statements=60
scripts.docs:check: vitest run docs/test examples/test && pnpm pack:test
scripts.conformance: node scripts/mcp-cli-smoke.mjs && pnpm --filter @mokimeow/jev-fabric-cli exec jev-fabric doctor --json
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm benchmark:check && pnpm release:check && pnpm pack:test
